title: FLARM / OGN: five aircraft and a relay
description: tools/scene_six.json on 868.8 MHz, 6 s looped: FLARM DD1234 (60 deg) and C81A2B (140), OGN glider 3C5A21 (230, ZK-GOX), a no-track paraglider D00F11 (310), an owner-encrypted OGN 1A2B3C (100) and a relay of 3C5A21 (no talker). Some packets at the same moment on 868.2 / 868.4 / 869.25 MHz. Expect five talkers at those bearings.
